title: Balance-Guided Forest for Causal Effect Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.05723v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Covariate balancing is widely used for estimating causal effects in observational studies. A central challenge is determining which covariate features should be balanced. Forest-kernel balancing provides a data-driven way to learn informative balancing features. Existing forest-kernel balancing methods first learn a tree-based representation and then construct balancing weights. However, this procedure creates a mismatch, as limited tree capacity may be spent on features that are already well represented. We propose Balance-Guided Forest (BGF), which uses the current balancing weights to guide subsequent tree construction. BGF grows trees using a novel splitting score that combines residual imbalance with an outcome contrast, favoring splits that separate outcome-relevant regions where imbalance remains. translated_title: 面向因果效应估计的平衡引导森林
translated_abstract: 协变量平衡被广泛应用于观察性研究中的因果效应估计。一个核心挑战是确定应该平衡哪些协变量特征。森林核平衡提供了一种数据驱动的方式来学习有信息量的平衡特征。现有的森林核平衡方法首先学习基于树的表示，然后构建平衡权重。然而，这一过程产生了不匹配问题，因为有限的树容量可能被用于那些已经得到充分表示的特征。我们提出平衡引导森林，它使用当前的平衡权重来引导后续的树构建。BGF采用一种新颖的分裂评分来生长树，该评分将残差不平衡与结果对比相结合，偏向于在仍然存在不平衡之处分离出与结果相关的区域的分裂。这将表示学习与协变量平衡耦合起来，而不是把平衡当作下游步骤。我们建立了一个……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出平衡引导森林（BGF），利用当前平衡权重引导树的生长，通过结合残差不平衡与结果对比的新型分裂评分，将表示学习与协变量平衡过程耦合，从而改进观察性研究中的因果效应估计。
en_tdlr: Proposes Balance-Guided Forest (BGF), which uses current balancing weights to guide tree construction via a novel splitting score combining residual imbalance with outcome contrast, coupling representation learning with covariate balancing to improve causal effect estimation in observational studies.
